G2.source: Published decisions of the Supreme Court of Florida on the discipline of Florida Bar members, indexed by CourtListener (Free Law Project)
G2.evidence: No attorney this firm names appears as the respondent in any of the 1237 published discipline decisions of the Supreme Court of Florida on the discipline of Florida Bar members, 1946 to 2026. G3.evidence: No matching active entity in the Florida corporate register. Florida does not require a sole proprietorship or a general partnership to register, so this is a check we could not complete from this source rather than evidence against the firm
G3.source: Corporate Data File, quarterly full snapshot, published by the Florida Department of State Division of Corporations, partial
G3.unresolvable: Florida does not require every law firm to register, so this register cannot answer for one that is not obliged to appear in it

G5.evidence: Site has served over HTTPS, a working phone number published, 1 named attorney published.

G6.evidence: 51 public client reviews across 1 Google listing, above the 10 minimum, and the firm's domain has been registered since 2020-02-17, so it has been operating for more than a year
